title: NVPanoptix-3D v1.1 Matterport3D model link recorded
summary: On 2026-03-24, the record recorded a link to an NVIDIA Hugging Face repository whose path identifies NVPanoptix-3D v1.1 for Matterport3D. This is proposed as a material historical step because it points to a versioned model artifact for the project. The link alone does not establish whether this was a release, update, or repost, so no capability or availability claims are made.
